proposals.title: SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL REGARDING SEMI-ANNUAL REPORT ON POLITICAL CONTRIBUTIONS
proposals.proponent: New York State Common Retirement Fund
proposals.topic_summary: Requests semiannually updated report disclosing policies and expenditures for political campaign and public influence contributions, including trade association payments.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends that you vote against this shareholder proposal.

proposals.title: SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL REGARDING EEO-1 DISCLOSURE
proposals.proponent: The Congregation of Benedictine Sisters, Boerne, Texas
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a diversity report with employee gender and race data by EEOC job category, affirmative action summaries, and diversity programs by September 2018.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends that you vote against this shareholder proposal.

proposals.title: SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL REGARDING SPECIAL SHAREHOLDER MEETINGS
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the board to amend bylaws so holders of 10% of outstanding common stock can call a special shareowner meeting.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends that you vote against this shareholder proposal.

proposals.title: SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL REGARDING AMENDMENT OF COMPENSATION CLAWBACK POLICY
proposals.proponent: International Brotherhood of Teamsters General Fund
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the committee to amend the executive clawback policy to allow recoupment for conduct causing financial or reputational harm and to disclose recoupment decisions.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends that you vote against this shareholder proposal.
